purpose: 10 district concept sheets for new units, enemies and asset ideas

sheets.title: 01 / KING'S ROAD
sheets.brief:
District: outer farms, pilgrim roads, market wards, bell towers. Warm limestone, dusty ochre road, weathered oak and royal teal; hopeful allies facing fallen heraldry.
Full-body lineup and exact labels:
"Swordsman": practical road veteran, short sword, lantern-buckle brigandine, folded teal shoulder cloak.
"Archer": hooded scout, tall ash bow, asymmetrical quiver, rolled rain cape.
"Shield Knight": broad iron silhouette, teal kite shield shaped around a brass lantern sigil, strong grounded pose.
"Risen": stooped former militia with split kettle helm, dragging billhook and decayed market-cloth.
"Ghoul": low fast predatory silhouette, elongated forearms, torn pilgrim hood.
"Grave Lord": substantially taller crowned skeleton commander, broken sun-halo crown, heavy sword and ruined crimson cloak.
Asset cluster: "Lantern Wagon" oak-and-black-iron caravan with large spoked wheels, amber rooftop shrine, teal shield plating; "Bell Gate" compact stone gatehouse with a broken bell turret; "Road Kit" stone milestone, harvest barricade, lantern post and grain sacks. Small icon/projectile cluster with labels "Arrow", "Heal", "Gold", "Guardian Shield"; visualize an ash-wood arrow, amber healing rite, chunky crown-stamped coins and a teal/brass shield relic. Bottom strip: pilgrim road toward a distant ruined keep.
sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one high-resolution landscape game concept sheet, new idea exploration for CROWNROAD: SIEGE OF ASH.
World: original medieval fantasy, Lantern Caravan versus Rotbound Host, a royal war wagon fighting toward an undead gatehouse. This is concept development for a side-view siege game.
Style/medium: polished painted 3D game concept art, sculpted road-worn royal miniatures, believable anatomy with broad readable stylization, distinctive chunky silhouettes, meticulously designed usable equipment. Oak, blue-black iron, antique brass, teal cloth and small amber lanterns unite allies. Bone, weathered iron, ruined crimson heraldry and restrained spectral or plague light unite enemies. Satin metal, woven cloth and worn leather; no plastic shine.
Composition: landscape 3:2 concept board on a warm light stone-paper background. Strong clean title, restrained editorial dividers, generous spacing. Upper 55 percent: a lineup of full-body separated named allied units, enemies and bosses, each clearly visible including feet and weapons. Respect their relative sizes. Lower 45 percent: separated wagon/fortification/landmark concepts, modular props, projectiles and small illustrated magic/relic/reward icon ideas. This is a design sheet, not one battlefield scene. Add a narrow small environment color-study strip. Character views are side-biased three-quarter, facing right, as if viewed 22 degrees above ground, usable as a future sprite design. Every object stays isolated and readable; do not overlap neighboring designs or crop.
Creative direction: develop fresh shapes, equipment, construction and personalities specific to this district; do not merely recolor generic soldiers. Show designs that can be modeled and animated. Keep shapes readable at small game scale, large meaningful details rather than noisy ornament.
Text: only the exact sheet title and the short supplied subject labels, correctly spelled, in clean legible typography. Tiny swatches can have no labels. No paragraphs, no invented stats, no watermark.
Avoid: modern firearms or vehicles, futuristic technology, sci-fi armor, generic repeated skeletons, photoreal grime, extreme gore, chibi bobbleheads, huge blooms hiding silhouettes, fake UI screenshots.

sheets.title: 02 / SALTWAKE DOCKS
sheets.brief:
District: tide-broken quays, chain cranes, drowned wreck piers and sea forts. Salt-white stone, grey-blue timber, patinated brass, subtle barnacles, wet rope and spectral turquoise.
Full-body lineup and exact labels:
"Spearman": harbor escort with a long boarding spear, oilskin shoulder wrap and narrow teal buckler.
"Crossbowman": dock marksman with a heavy timber crossbow, compact winch mechanism, bolted teal pavise carried on back.
"Rot Hulk": huge swollen drowned sailor, broken mooring chains and a ship bell embedded in shoulder, heavy rounded silhouette.
"Tidecaller": undead ritual admiral in torn tidal robes, crescent anchor staff and a crown of wreck timbers.
"Harrow Tidemaster": distinct larger boss, reef-like black armor, enormous anchor-blade, broad broken ship-wheel halo and spectral water spilling from armor.
Asset cluster: "Royal Wagon" coastal caravan with teal royal awnings, brass lantern and rope-secured luggage, keep it on wheels; "Chain Crane" medieval timber chainlift and a separated sea-fort gate silhouette; "Dock Kit" mooring bollard, stacked crab pots, buoy lantern, rope coil and wreck plank barricade. Small illustrated ideas with labels "Harpoon", "Bolt", "Barrier Ward", "Frostbound Crown": two separate readable projectile objects, a translucent ward around an amber lantern, and an icy iron crown relic. Bottom strip: drowned quay with skeletal ship masts.

sheets.title: 03 / EMBERFORGE MARCH
sheets.brief:
District: coal spurs, medieval smelter rows, furnace bridges and forge-crown battlements. Soot-black iron, warm timber, bright orange ember seams and restrained royal teal. Mechanical parts are medieval siege engineering.
Full-body lineup and exact labels:
"Siege Engineer": sturdy apron-wearing artisan, giant field wrench/hammer, teal tool roll and portable ratchet winch.
"Alchemist": agile armored flask thrower, leather chemical harness, brass cage around glass vessels, scorched teal half-cape.
"Sapper": crouched skeletal saboteur carrying a barrel charge, fuse and pickaxe, pointed shoulders.
"Bone Juggernaut": towering broad bone-plated breaker, asymmetric ram-like arm and riveted cage torso.
"Iron Warden": squat massive furnace-armored boss, grate chest, twin chimney shoulders and enormous two-handed hammer.
"Ashen Regent": taller lean burned royal swordsman, flame-tipped crown, ash-grey cape and cracked ember sword; clearly unlike the Warden.
Asset cluster: "Forge Wagon" iron-plated caravan with shielded amber shrine and spare wheel/tool racks, not a steam locomotive; "Firepot Mount" swivel-mounted medieval brass/iron firepot launcher; "Forge Kit" coal basket, quench trough, broken anvil and furnace barricade. Icon/projectile ideas labelled "Firepot", "Flask", "Cog", "Fireball", "Iron Heart": three distinct projectile objects, compact fireball spell study, a glowing iron-heart relic. Bottom strip: furnace bridge under ash clouds.

sheets.title: 04 / ASHEN WARD
sheets.brief:
District: plague cloisters, purge halls, sealed courts and ritual vaults. Chalk stone, ash-grey burial cloth, tarnished brass, amber protective lanterns opposed to sickly lime light.
Full-body lineup and exact labels:
"Battle Monk": compact grounded martial healer, bandaged hands, iron prayer staff, layered ivory-and-teal cloth, belt lantern.
"Lantern Guard": shielded ritual sentinel, closed helm, rectangular brass-framed lamp-shield with amber core and short warding mace.
"Blight Caster": hunched plague cultist with ceramic vessel backpack, bent stave, hanging glass contagion globes.
"Hexer": thin masked ritual disruptor, split robe silhouette, suspended ward-breaker charms and a hooked tuning-fork wand.
"Plague Archon": tall skeletal bishop-like boss with a tall censers-and-bone mitre, iron incense flail, deliberately open rib silhouette.
"Plague Monarch": much broader grotesque royal boss seated within its own walking armor silhouette, crown of sealed vials, green haze inside a metal ribcage; avoid gore.
Asset cluster: "Guild Wagon" protected caravan with cloth shutters, brass purification lanterns and practical guild insignia; "Hex Mount" separately designed cage of ward-breaking charms mounted on a wooden turntable; "Cloister Kit" sealed ward door, purge brazier, ash urn and portable chalk-rune barricade. Small studies labelled "Blight Glob", "Plague Pot", "Resurrect", "Plague Censer": two projectiles, rising spectral figure inside an amber rune circle, and a caged censer relic. Bottom strip: silent plague cloister with closed iron doors.

sheets.title: 05 / THORNWALL PASS
sheets.brief:
District: cliff roads, mountain watch forts and avalanche shrines. Wind-scoured slate, cold mist, evergreen teal, ochre hide, rope and weathered brass.
Full-body lineup and exact labels:
"Halberdier": tall mountain road guard, long triangular-bladed polearm, layered mail and short teal climbing cape.
"Berserker": stocky fur-mantled ally, two-handed axe, exposed forearms, rope-bound boots and a small amber charm.
"Grave Brute": heavy crooked undead mountain laborer, stone slab hammer, lopsided shoulder harness and exposed bone jaw.
"Tunneler": low burrowing undead with huge digging claws, collapsed mining helm and a coil of root-like bone plates; clearly not a human with just a shovel.
"Thornwall Chieftain": huge mountain grave-lord boss in layered slate armor, ram-horn crown, fur cape and a broken watchtower beam as weapon.
Asset cluster: "Iron Wagon" caravan with reinforced wheel bands, chain brakes, windproof shrine and compact angular roof; "Frost Mount" ice-crystal siege emitter in an iron cage with manual winch; "Pass Kit" rope bridge section, squat watchtower, cairn shrine, spiked palisade. Small studies labelled "Frost Shard", "Frost Burst", "Stone Barricade", "Siege Hammer": distinct ice projectile, radial frost spell, raised stone slabs and a heavy iron hammer relic. Bottom strip: narrow ridge road with a small watch fort.

sheets.title: 06 / HOLLOW BASILICA
sheets.brief:
District: ruined cathedrals, ossuary plazas, reliquary vaults and necromantic ceremony. Old ivory, dark plum, black iron, tarnished gilding; allies retain visible teal and amber while enemy rites glow spectral mint.
Full-body lineup and exact labels:
"Necromancer": allied battle necromancer with practical teal/ivory robes, chained spellbook, small amber soul-lantern and a carved bone staff; clearly Lantern Caravan rather than enemy faction.
"Mage": royal field caster in layered teal traveling robes, brass-ring staff with compact magical crystal, scroll harness.
"Lich": floating narrow skeletal scholar, tattered dark robes, vertical skull staff and spectral light inside an open book.
"Catacomb Giant": huge constructed guardian with stacked tomb slabs, articulated bone arms and a small cage of souls in its chest.
"Bone Pontiff": undead cathedral patriarch with a branching bone mitre, broad skeletal vestments and rib-shaped crozier.
"Reliquary Tyrant": distinct squat heavily armored boss whose upper body is a walking gilded reliquary cabinet, skull visible behind a grilled window, short crushing mace.
Asset cluster: "Bone Wagon" allied caravan with carved ivory reinforcement and teal shrine canopy, keep amber faction light; "Ossuary Gate" monumental but compact skeletal cathedral gate; "Vault Kit" broken reliquary chest, ossuary arch section, prayer candles and tombstone barricade. Small studies labelled "Skull", "Tomes", "Grave Crown", "Spectral Lantern": ghost-skull projectile, stacked spellbooks reward, jagged old crown relic and spectral lantern relic. Bottom strip: basilica nave open to the night.

sheets.brief:

Small ideas labelled "Ballista Bolt", "Bone Bolt", "Earthquake", "Crown of Valor": two contrasting projectile designs, stone-fracture spell icon and royal lantern crown relic.
